title: Capital One Shopping Tech, Staff Full Stack Engineer, Technical Chief of Staff (Remote - Eligible)
description_html: Capital One Shopping Tech, Staff Full Stack Engineer, Technical Chief of Staff (Remote - Eligible)      Capital One Shopping is a product organization that operates autonomously within Capital One. Our products (a browser extension, plus web and mobile apps) reach tens of millions of shoppers. To keep moving fast inside a large regulated enterprise, Shopping needs someone who holds the full picture of what the org is doing and where it is headed, and who uses that picture to clear the enterprise-level roadblocks in front of it.      This is a senior individual-contributor role, not a people-management role. You hold the current picture of what is happening across Shopping and what is coming next, represent that work to the wider Capital One enterprise, and get Shopping unblocked with enterprise platform, security, risk, compliance, and procurement teams. The role needs enough hands-on engineering depth to represent that work credibly to those teams.       What You'll Do :      Keep a current, org-wide picture of Shopping's work: what teams are shipping now, what is planned, and where the technical and business dependencies sit.      Use that knowledge to influence the enterprise ahead of need: line up the platform support, tools, access, and approvals that Shopping's future work will depend on, before they become blockers.      Prepare and present Shopping's progress and goals to Capital One senior leadership, and secure the decisions, investment, and buy-in that the work needs.      Navigate enterprise governance (security, risk, compliance, procurement, platform standards) on Shopping's behalf, and broker between Shopping and central platform and infrastructure teams.      Drive cross-team dependency orchestration on major, cross-cutting efforts. This is an occasional need during big initiatives, not an ongoing program-management role.      Represent Shopping's engineering firsthand. Explain and defend our architecture and technical choices directly to enterprise platform, security, and risk partners, with the depth to hold those conversations on your own.        Basic Qualifications:      Bachelor's Degree or higher in Computer Science or a related quantitative field (Statistics, Economics, Operations Research, Analytics, Mathematics, Engineering)      At least 7 years of experience in all of the following:      Software engineering and solution architecture      Enterprise architecture and design patterns      Cloud computing (AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud)      Data architecture          Preferred Qualifications:      Master’s Degree in Computer Science or Software Engineering      10+ years of experience in all of the following:      Software engineering and solution architecture      Enterprise architecture and design patterns      Web technologies (JavaScript, TypeScript and SPA frameworks)      Designing and building distributed HPC and ML systems       Cloud computing (AWS, Microsoft Azure, Google Cloud)      Data architecture        10+ years of professional experience coding in commonly used languages like Go, Java, JavaScript/Typescript, Python, Rust, C#, Scala       8+ years of experience with database and database management systems      10+ years of professional experience in the full lifecycle of system development, from conception through architecture, implementation, testing, deployment and production support      5+ years of experience with public cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure), cloud-based productivity tools, or virtualization technologies      10+ years of experience with Networking protocols and integration with third party distributed systems      5+ years of experience mentoring senior engineers and driving professional development within technical teams      2+ years of experience leading cross-domain architectural reviews and establishing coding and design standards      Expertise in the strategic application of agentic AI coding tools to solve systemic development challenges        Capital One will consider sponsoring a new qualified applicant for employment authorization for this position. McLean, VA: $269,100 - $307,200 for Staff Full-stack Engineer                                            Candidates hired to work in other locations will be subject to the pay range associated with that location, and the actual annualized salary amount offered to any candidate at the time of hire will be reflected solely in the candidate’s offer letter.
